Usage: zealakit add [options] <recipes...>

Add recipes to an existing project (reads zealakit.json; previews a diff first)

Options:
  --cwd <dir>        Project directory (default: current directory)
  --dry-run          Show what would change without writing
  -y, --yes          Apply without asking for confirmation
  --force            Proceed even when the git working tree is dirty
  --overwrite-files  Replace files you edited with the kit's version (originals
                     are backed up)
  --install          Install dependencies afterwards
  --no-install       Do not install dependencies
  --pm <manager>     Package manager for install (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun; default:
                     from lockfile)
  --app <name>       Stack member to add to (workspace projects)
  --trust-external   Apply external (path or github:) recipes without asking
  --json             Machine-readable output (needs -y or --dry-run)
  -h, --help         display help for command
